events.title: 10-Day Satipaṭṭhāna Vipassanā Course
events.locationOrLink: Group Retreat Hall · Main Dhamma Sanctuary
events.teacher: Ven. Dr. Nandamālābhivaṃsa & Senior Assistant Sayadaw
events.description: Ten-day intensive retreat following the Mahāsatipaṭṭhāna Sutta with alternating sitting and walking periods, evening Abhidhamma & Vipassanā discourses, and daily teacher interviews.

events.title: Weekly Sunday Group Sitting & Abhidhamma Study
events.description: One-hour silent Vipassanā sitting followed by 30 minutes of walking meditation, chanting of the Mettā Sutta, and guided reading from Fundamental Abhidhamma.

events.title: Practical Paṭiccasamuppāda Seminar (Mogok Tradition)
events.description: Focused afternoon discourse and Q&A exploring how contemplation of consciousness (cittānupassanā) severs the link between feeling (vedanā) and craving (taṇhā).

events.title: Full-Moon Uposatha One-Day Mindfulness Retreat
events.description: One-day Eight Precepts observance with guided Ānāpānasati sitting, mindful vegetarian lunch, and group sutta recitation.

formTabs.label: Course Registration
formTabs.description: Register for upcoming 10-day Vipassanā retreats, one-day Uposatha sittings, and weekly group meditation courses.

formTabs.label: Questions for Sayadaw
formTabs.description: Submit meditation practice questions or Abhidhamma / Sutta study inquiries for upcoming Sayadaw Q&A sessions.

formTabs.label: Volunteer & Dāna Support
formTabs.description: Offer Dhamma service, course meal coordination, audio transcription, or Pāli translation assistance for the group.
